# Exhibition Stalls Designs
> Exhibition stall designer and fabricator in Pakistan since 2020. Design, 3D rendering, fabrication, graphics printing, installation, dismantling and show-day support, all in-house. Workshops in Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Faisalabad and Multan, serving exhibitions across Pakistan. Also event setup, customized kiosk manufacturing, ticket counters and booth gates.

## Key facts
- Founded 2020. Head workshop: Karachi (Office 202, 2nd Floor, Sadia Press Centre, Block 2, Nazimabad, 74600). Islamabad: Plot # 78, Street 6, I-10/3, 44000. Lahore: 1st Floor, 69-B Main Blvd Gulberg, Block H, Gulberg 2, 54660. Fabrication in Islamabad and Lahore happens in the basement warehouse of those buildings.
- Starting prices (PKR, installed): 10x10 basic package 13,000; kiosk 15,000; shell scheme stall 15,000; Octanorm stall 18,000; 10x20 booth 25,000; 20x20 booth 50,000; island booth 50,000; double-deck booth 100,000.
- Prices cover design, fabrication, graphics printing, installation, execution and dismantling, including power, furniture, LED screens and transport to other cities. Final quote depends on requirements.
- We both rent and sell stalls. Prices are totals per event of up to three days; sizes are in feet (10x10 = 10 by 10 feet). Contact us for customized pricing based on event dynamics. Our workshops have CNC machines.
- Payment: 60% upfront, 40% on installation and complete setup. Quotes within 24 hours. Design sign-off needed at least one week before the event. Revisions are not capped.
- Typical installation: crew of 5 to 10 people, about three days. Show-day support offered. Test assembly in the workshop where a project calls for it.
- We design, fabricate, install and dismantle stalls. We do not organise exhibitions or sell floor space: organisers set space fees separately from our stall prices.
- Contact: hello@exhibitionstallsdesigns.com, phone and WhatsApp +92 323 2899503 (team replies 24/7). Workshops are not open to walk-in visits.
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Exhibitionstallsdesigns/ . LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/company/exhibition-stalls-designs
